newsitem.title: GREECE: ALICO-EUROBANK FUNDS EYE N.GREECE WITH SALONICA OFFICE.
newsitem.headline: ALICO-EUROBANK FUNDS EYE N.GREECE WITH SALONICA OFFICE.

text.p: Alico Eurobank Fund Management is making a foray into the northern Greek market with the launch of its new office in Thessaloniki, it said on Wednesday.
The fund management company is targeting the savings market of Greece's second largest city, offering a wide range of invvestment choices through its mutual funds.
Building on its presence in Thessaloniki, Alico Eurobank will expand with a network of branches in northern Greece.

"Already, our offices in Serres and Ioannina are doing well while funds under management by all three offices exceed 4.5 billion drachmas," said general manager Alex Pappas during the opening reception. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
